locked.name: Locked
locked.explanation: This element unlocks when the condition is met.

maximum.name: Maximum
maximum.explanation: You cannot hold or use more than this number.

purchase-limit.name: Purchase Limit
purchase-limit.explanation: The maximum number of times this can be purchased.

purchasable-count.name: Purchasable
purchasable-count.explanation: Shows how many more times this can be purchased.

navigation.name: Navigation
navigation.explanation: You can also swipe to move between columns. A "Top" button appears at the bottom left of the screen.

navigation-column.name: Column
navigation-column.explanation: The position of this column and the total number of columns, including those off-screen.

activity.name: Activity
activity.explanation: A list of available Actions, grouped by Category.

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.explanation: A list of Items you own, grouped by Category.

status.name: Status
status.explanation: Shows the current state, such as bonuses applied to a Category.

ability.name: Ability
ability.explanation: A list of the skills that can trigger right now, grouped by category.

overview.name: Overview
overview.explanation: Shows an overview of this World and the console running it.

estimated-playing-time.name: Estimated Playing Time
estimated-playing-time.explanation: The time the author estimates it takes to complete this World.

language-change-enable-general.name: Changeable
language-change-enable-general.explanation: The display language can be changed in the settings screen.

max-category-level.name: Max Category Level
max-category-level.explanation: The maximum Level each Category can reach.

level-common-ratio.name: Level Growth Ratio
level-common-ratio.explanation: Shows how much the Experience needed for the next Level increases each time you Level up.

console.name: Console
console.explanation: This game runs on the "Idle RPG" console system. It is free and publicly available, so anyone can create a game.

coin.name: Coin
coin.explanation: An Item used as currency for buying and selling.

play-time.name: Play Time
play-time.explanation: The date and time you started playing, and how long you have played.

play-started.name: Start Date
play-started.explanation: The date and time you started playing.

play-duration.name: Elapsed Time
play-duration.explanation: The time elapsed since you started playing.

coins-earned.name: Coins Earned
coins-earned.explanation: The total amount of each Coin earned so far.

unique-count.name: Unique Count
unique-count.explanation: The number of distinct types you can hold at once.

max-capacity.name: Capacity
max-capacity.explanation: The current maximum number of Item types you can hold.

max-queue.name: Queue
max-queue.explanation: The current maximum number of Actions the Queue can hold.

statistics-category.name: Category
statistics-category.explanation: Shows how many Categories in this World have been unlocked.

statistics-action.name: Action
statistics-action.explanation: Shows how many Actions in this World have been unlocked.

statistics-item.name: Item
statistics-item.explanation: Shows how many Items in this World have been unlocked.

statistics-event.name: Event
statistics-event.explanation: Shows how many Events in this World have been unlocked.

count-unlocked.name: Unlocked
count-unlocked.explanation: The number unlocked so far, out of the total.

level-total.name: Total Level
level-total.explanation: The sum of all Category Levels, and its maximum.

count-performed.name: Performed
count-performed.explanation: The total number of times Actions have been performed.

count-earned.name: Earned
count-earned.explanation: The total number of Items earned so far.

count-triggered.name: Triggered
count-triggered.explanation: The total number of times Events have occurred.

debug.name: Debug
debug.explanation: Provides tools for testing the World. Only available in debug mode.

acceleration.name: Acceleration
acceleration.explanation: Speeds up the passage of time in the game. Raising the speed too high while Actions have short execution times may cause processing to fall behind, freezing or crashing the app, so use caution.

skip.name: Skip
skip.explanation: Advances in-game time at once without waiting.

skip-hour.name: Skip 1 Hour
skip-hour.explanation: Advances the game by 1 hour at once. Progress is processed the same as while away, and the results are shown in a notification.

adjustment.name: Value Adjustment
adjustment.explanation: Increases or decreases the number of Items held or Category Levels.

adjustment-category.name: Category
adjustment-category.explanation: Adjusts a Category's Level. For example, setting +5 raises the Level by 5.

adjustment-action.name: Action
adjustment-action.explanation: This increases or decreases the number of times the Action has been performed. However, rewards earned by completing the Action are not applied.

adjustment-item.name: Item
adjustment-item.explanation: Increases or decreases the number of Items held.

adjustment-id.name: ID
adjustment-id.explanation: Specify the ID of the target type. If left blank, the addition or subtraction applies to all IDs.

adjustment-count.name: Count
adjustment-count.explanation: The amount to increase or decrease. Use the sign to specify plus or minus.

adjustment-adjust.name: Adjust
adjustment-adjust.explanation: Performs the adjustment with the specified conditions.

iconify.name: Iconify
iconify.explanation: This game uses icon sets provided by Iconify. Thanks to everyone who contributed to their creation.

standalone.name: Standalone
standalone.explanation: Runs independently, regardless of Action progress in other Categories.

actions.name: Action List
actions.explanation: A list of Actions belonging to this Category.

attribute.name: Attribute
attribute.explanation: An attribute unique to this Action. The Category's Properties are applied to this Attribute, and Experience is also granted to it.

persistent.name: Persistent
persistent.explanation: Performs a series of Actions, granting a reward each time an Action is completed.

single.name: Single
single.explanation: Can be performed only once. Progress is saved even if interrupted midway.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.explanation: Each time the Action is performed, both the Player's and the Target's Stamina decrease. When the Target's Stamina runs out, you win; when the Player's Stamina runs out, it's game over. Nothing is lost on game over, but all Actions in progress are interrupted.

act.name: Act
act.explanation: Starts or stops this Action and shows its progress.

reserve.name: Reserve
reserve.explanation: Adds this Action to the reservation Queue to be performed in order.

reorder.name: Reorder
reorder.explanation: Applies the chosen count and order to this Action in the Queue. Moving an Action in progress to position 1 or later stops it and returns it to waiting.

position.name: Position
position.explanation: Choose this Action's position in the Queue. 0 is the front, pushing back the Action in progress and performing this one immediately. 1 or later waits at that position.

now.name: Now
now.explanation: Places this Action at the front of the Queue and performs it immediately.

acquisition-failure.name: Failure Reward
acquisition-failure.explanation: Rewards marked [Failure] can only be earned when the Action fails. The percentage shown is the chance of earning it.

items.name: Item List
items.explanation: A list of Items belonging to this Category.

normal.name: Normal
normal.explanation: A normal Item that can be owned, equipped, and traded.

capacity.name: Capacity
capacity.explanation: A special Item representing the number of Item types you can own at once.

queue.name: Queue
queue.explanation: A special Item representing the number of Actions that can be placed in the Queue. The Action currently in progress at the front is included in this count.

recovery.name: Recovery
recovery.explanation: The percentage of Stamina recovered at the start of combat.

equipment-type.name: Equipment Type
equipment-type.explanation: The Equipment Type of this Item.

necessary-item.name: Necessary
necessary-item.explanation: The effect activates when this Item is equipped.

unnecessary-item.name: Unnecessary
unnecessary-item.explanation: This Item cannot be equipped, but its effect activates just by owning it. The effect multiplies by the number owned.

consumable-item.name: Consumable
consumable-item.explanation: Has an effect when equipped, but is consumed each time the Action is performed.

buy.name: Buy
buy.explanation: The price when buying this Item.

buying-value.name: Buying Value
buying-value.explanation: The price when buying this Item.

sell.name: Sell
sell.explanation: The price when selling this Item.

selling.name: Sell
selling.explanation: Choose an Item you own from the list and sell it.

selling-value.name: Selling Value
selling-value.explanation: The price when selling this Item.

queue-full.name: Queue Full
queue-full.explanation: The Queue is full, including the Action in progress.

already-queued.name: Already Queued
already-queued.explanation: This Action is already in the Queue.

purchase-limit-reached.name: Purchase Limit Reached
purchase-limit-reached.explanation: The purchase limit has been reached.

completed-maximum.name: Completion Limit
completed-maximum.explanation: The number of completions has reached its limit.

relationship-items.name: Related Items
relationship-items.explanation: A list of items related to this category's actions.

skill.name: Skill
skill.explanation: It is drawn each turn in combat, and when it triggers it corrects the combat values for that turn only.

skills.name: Skill List
skills.explanation: A list of the skills this element has.

no-ability.name: No ability
no-ability.explanation: There are no skills that can trigger right now.

properties.name: Property List
properties.explanation: A list of Properties belonging to this Category.

accuracy.name: Accuracy
accuracy.explanation: The chance of dealing damage to the monster.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.explanation: The chance of taking damage from the monster.

restore.name: Restore
restore.explanation: Affects the amount recovered during combat.

speed.name: Speed
speed.explanation: Affects the speed of the Action.

chance.name: Chance
chance.explanation: This Action may also succeed, but if it fails, you get no reward or Experience.

experience.name: Experience
experience.explanation: Affects the Experience gained from the Action.

base-value.name: Base Value
base-value.explanation: A value unique to this game or Action.

level-gap.name: Level Gap
level-gap.explanation: For the calculation, see the "Level" block.

reflected-value.name: Reflected Value
reflected-value.explanation: The final value calculated from "Base Value" and "Level Gap".

level-gap-property.name: Level Gap Property
level-gap-property.explanation: The "Level Gap" value is the sum of each value in this block.

level-gap-category.name: Level Gap Category
level-gap-category.explanation: The value obtained by subtracting this Action's Level from the Player's Category Level. For "Experience", however, this is reversed.

level-gap-action.name: Level Gap Action
level-gap-action.explanation: When the Progress Type is "Stamina", a value unique to this Action set by it.

level-gap-item.name: Level Gap Item
level-gap-item.explanation: A bonus value from equipped Items, or Items whose effect activates without being equipped.

no-status.name: No Status
no-status.explanation: There are no available Status Categories.

timing.name: Timing
timing.explanation: The timing when this Event occurs.

timing-matched.name: Condition Met
timing-matched.explanation: Occurs the moment the condition is met.

timing-comebacked.name: Comeback
timing-comebacked.explanation: Occurs when you return after being away for a while.

timing-gameovered.name: Game Over
timing-gameovered.explanation: Occurs when Stamina runs out during combat.

timing-welcomed.name: First Launch
timing-welcomed.explanation: Occurs when you open this World for the first time.

timing-completed.name: Complete
timing-completed.explanation: Occurs when all Categories reach their maximum Level.

timing-obtained.name: Obtained
timing-obtained.explanation: Occurs when a Single Action is completed.

comebacked.name: Comebacked
comebacked.explanation: Welcome back! Here's what happened while you were away:

gameovered.name: Gameovered
gameovered.explanation: Game over. Progress has been reset.

completed.name: Completed
completed.explanation: Congratulations! You have completed all Categories.

receive.name: Receive
receive.explanation: Receive the reward for this Task.

received.name: Received
received.explanation: The reward for this Task has already been received.

hidden.name: Hidden
hidden.explanation: Once you check the content, this column will be hidden.

tasks.name: Task List
tasks.explanation: A list of Tasks set for this Category.

missions.name: Missions
missions.explanation: A list of Tasks across all Categories and their completion status.

config.name: Config
config.explanation: Change this game's settings and manage save data.

display.name: Display
display.explanation: Change how the game is displayed on screen.

language.name: Language
language.explanation: Change the language used for display.

language-change-enable.name: Language Change Enable
language-change-enable.explanation: The display language can be changed.

language-change-unenable.name: Language Change Unenable
language-change-unenable.explanation: There are no other languages available for display.

category-shortcut.name: Category Shortcut
category-shortcut.explanation: When you open a Category, also show its Action List or Item List.

showing-hint.name: Hint
showing-hint.explanation: Shows explanations of how to operate the game.

showing-navigation.name: Navigation
showing-navigation.explanation: Shows buttons for moving between columns. Even without showing the buttons, you can move between columns by swiping.

performance.name: Performance
performance.explanation: Adjusts behavior to suit your device.

performing-highly.name: Performing Highly
performing-highly.explanation: Increases the update frequency. If performance is heavy, turning this off is recommended. Does not affect the execution time of each Action.

data.name: Data
data.explanation: Save, load, or delete this World's progress data.

import-mistake.name: Import Mistake
import-mistake.explanation: Failed to load the game data.

reset-game.name: Reset Game
reset-game.explanation: Deletes all progress data for this World. This action cannot be undone. After confirming that you really want to delete the file, type "DELETE" into the input field. (Not required in debug mode.)

reset-alert.name: Reset Alert
reset-alert.explanation: Resetting the game erases all data. Are you sure you want to reset the game?

reset-debug-mode.name: Reset Debug Mode
reset-debug-mode.explanation: In debug mode, no input is required in the confirmation field.

restart.name: Restart
restart.explanation: Reloads the console. Used to check whether the build has been updated.

hint-language-switching.name: Hint Language Switching
hint-language-switching.explanation: Switches the language displayed in the game.

hint-language-availability.name: Hint Language Availability
hint-language-availability.explanation: Only available when the author has provided a translation.

hint-event-timing.name: Hint Event Timing
hint-event-timing.explanation: Occurs at set timings, such as when you return to the game or when it's game over.

hint-event-reward.name: Hint Event Reward
hint-event-reward.explanation: When it occurs, this screen opens and a reward is automatically granted along with a message.

hint-event-task.name: Hint Event Task
hint-event-task.explanation: A Task is completed when its condition is met, and you receive the reward yourself.

hint-debug-visibility.name: Hint Debug Visibility
hint-debug-visibility.explanation: This is shown only during debugging.

hint-debug-publishing.name: Hint Debug Publishing
hint-debug-publishing.explanation: Not shown when the game is published or distributed.

hint-config-settings.name: Hint Config Settings
hint-config-settings.explanation: Configure settings related to the game's display and processing.

hint-config-data.name: Hint Config Data
hint-config-data.explanation: You can read, write, or reset game data.

hint-statistics-progress.name: Hint Statistics Progress
hint-statistics-progress.explanation: You can check the game's progress so far.

hint-overview-world.name: Hint Overview World
hint-overview-world.explanation: You can check this game's World (setting and lore).

hint-overview-console.name: Hint Overview Console
hint-overview-console.explanation: You can also check the console (system) running this game.

hint-properties-list.name: Hint Properties List
hint-properties-list.explanation: A list of Properties set for each Category.

hint-properties-meaning.name: Hint Properties Meaning
hint-properties-meaning.explanation: Properties are elements that affect the performance of Actions.

hint-properties-equipment.name: Hint Properties Equipment
hint-properties-equipment.explanation: The effect is adjusted by equipping Items (some Items do not require equipping).

hint-trade-availability.name: Hint Trade Availability
hint-trade-availability.explanation: Some Items cannot be bought or sold.

hint-trade-locked.name: Hint Trade Locked
hint-trade-locked.explanation: Locked Items cannot be bought or sold.

hint-trade-limit.name: Hint Trade Limit
hint-trade-limit.explanation: The Capacity and Queue may have a limit on the number of times they can be purchased; once the limit is reached, no more can be purchased (increases from rewards are not subject to the limit).

hint-items-equipping.name: Hint Items Equipping
hint-items-equipping.explanation: Hold to toggle equipping the Item.

hint-items-exclusive.name: Hint Items Exclusive
hint-items-exclusive.explanation: Only one Item in the list can be equipped (when the Category is set to allow equipping).

hint-items-locked.name: Hint Items Locked
hint-items-locked.explanation: Items that don't meet their unlock condition are locked, and their details cannot be viewed.

hint-item-meaning.name: Hint Item Meaning
hint-item-meaning.explanation: Items are elements related to what you hold, such as equipment, consumables, and valuables.

hint-item-exclusive.name: Hint Item Exclusive
hint-item-exclusive.explanation: Only one Item can be equipped within a single Category (when the Category is set to allow equipping).

hint-item-locked.name: Hint Item Locked
hint-item-locked.explanation: Items that don't meet their unlock condition are locked, and their details cannot be viewed.

hint-act-count.name: Hint Act Count
hint-act-count.explanation: You can specify the number of times to perform it. Choosing the rightmost option performs it until resources run out.

hint-queue-removing.name: Hint Queue Removing
hint-queue-removing.explanation: Hold the bar to remove it from the Queue. Since the front is in progress, it stops and the next one begins.

hint-actions-executing.name: Hint Actions Executing
hint-actions-executing.explanation: Hold to toggle performing the Action.

hint-actions-exclusive.name: Hint Actions Exclusive
hint-actions-exclusive.explanation: Only one Action can be performed within a single Category.

hint-actions-parallel.name: Hint Actions Parallel
hint-actions-parallel.explanation: Depending on the Category, Actions in multiple Categories can progress at the same time.

hint-actions-locked.name: Hint Actions Locked
hint-actions-locked.explanation: Actions that don't meet their unlock condition are locked, and their details cannot be viewed.

hint-action-experience.name: Hint Action Experience
hint-action-experience.explanation: Each time it is performed, you gain Experience and may Level up.

hint-action-resource.name: Hint Action Resource
hint-action-resource.explanation: Each time it is performed, Items are consumed or gained.

hint-action-locked.name: Hint Action Locked
hint-action-locked.explanation: Actions that don't meet their unlock condition are locked, and their details cannot be viewed.

hint-tasks-list.name: Hint Tasks List
hint-tasks-list.explanation: A list of Tasks assigned to this Category.

hint-tasks-detail.name: Hint Tasks Detail
hint-tasks-detail.explanation: Select a Task to check its completion condition and reward.

hint-tasks-unclaimed.name: Hint Tasks Unclaimed
hint-tasks-unclaimed.explanation: Tasks whose reward hasn't been claimed yet have a ribbon. Select it and press Receive to claim it.

hint-tasks-capacity.name: Hint Tasks Capacity
hint-tasks-capacity.explanation: You cannot receive the reward while the number of Item types you can hold has reached its limit. Make room, then try receiving it again.

hint-tasks-empty.name: Hint Tasks Empty
hint-tasks-empty.explanation: Not shown if the Category has no Tasks.

hint-category-meaning.name: Hint Category Meaning
hint-category-meaning.explanation: An element that groups together Actions and Items.

hint-status-property.name: Hint Status Property
hint-status-property.explanation: Only the property value that items apply to the category is shown.

hint-status-action.name: Hint Status Action
hint-status-action.explanation: Depending on the Action performed, additional bonuses may apply.

hint-inventory-equipping.name: Hint Inventory Equipping
hint-inventory-equipping.explanation: Hold to toggle equipping the Item.

hint-activity-executing.name: Hint Activity Executing
hint-activity-executing.explanation: Hold to toggle performing the Action.

hint-missions-grouping.name: Hint Missions Grouping
hint-missions-grouping.explanation: Tasks are grouped and shown by Category.

hint-missions-ungrouped.name: Hint Missions Ungrouped
hint-missions-ungrouped.explanation: Tasks with no Category set are grouped at the top.

hint-missions-unclaimed.name: Hint Missions Unclaimed
hint-missions-unclaimed.explanation: Tasks whose reward hasn't been claimed yet have a ribbon. Select it and press Receive to claim it.

hint-missions-permanent.name: Hint Missions Permanent
hint-missions-permanent.explanation: Once a Task is completed, it stays completed even if the condition is no longer met afterward.

hint-attack-scope.name: Hint Attack Scope
hint-attack-scope.explanation: Opening from a Category shows a list of contributing Items; opening from an Item shows a list of affected Categories.

hint-defence-scope.name: Hint Defence Scope
hint-defence-scope.explanation: Opening from a Category shows a list of contributing Items; opening from an Item shows a list of affected Categories.

hint-accuracy-scope.name: Hint Accuracy Scope
hint-accuracy-scope.explanation: Opening from a Category shows a list of contributing Items; opening from an Item shows a list of affected Categories.

hint-evasion-scope.name: Hint Evasion Scope
hint-evasion-scope.explanation: Opening from a Category shows a list of contributing Items; opening from an Item shows a list of affected Categories.

hint-restore-scope.name: Hint Restore Scope
hint-restore-scope.explanation: Opening from a Category shows a list of contributing Items; opening from an Item shows a list of affected Categories.

hint-speed-scope.name: Hint Speed Scope
hint-speed-scope.explanation: Opening from a Category shows a list of contributing Items; opening from an Item shows a list of affected Categories.

hint-chance-scope.name: Hint Chance Scope
hint-chance-scope.explanation: Opening from a Category shows a list of contributing Items; opening from an Item shows a list of affected Categories.

hint-experience-scope.name: Hint Experience Scope
hint-experience-scope.explanation: Opening from a Category shows a list of contributing Items; opening from an Item shows a list of affected Categories.
